name: PolylineOnPlaneParallelogram
_comment: Gallery of the sketch_polyline_on_plane primitive: a non-axis-aligned closed 4-point parallelogram on the Top plane, extruded mid-plane along the plane normal (+/-Y). This is the SM-HW-S1b-009 BeltEndChute floor profile (a 45 deg slope), which sketch_rectangle_on_plane (axis-aligned) and sketch_polygon (regular N-gon) cannot express. Unlike sketch_3d_sketch (whose extrude only ever runs +Z), a polyline on a standard plane extrudes along that plane's normal.

features.name: SK_FloorParallelogram
features._comment: Closed parallelogram, Top-plane sketch-local mm: (0,0) -> (8,8) -> (6.586,9.414) -> (-1.414,1.414). 45 deg slanted sides; auto-closed.

features.name: BOSS_FloorSlab
features._comment: Extrude the parallelogram 40 mm centred on the Top plane -> +/-20 mm along +/-Y (the plane normal).
